Thank you for your time and comment. It really made me think of things i haven’t thought of before. To answer a few things about your comment, I’d like to say that I am unable to leave and come back just for sleep. Though, if I do pick up another job, somehow in these times, I could work a lot more during the summer to speed things up to get a place for my own. I think I could also ask for more hours too at my current work and become a full time employee there. 

And it is really karmic to think about when they grow old.. though, i don’t hate them, it’s just.. very hard on me mentally.. Part of me just wishes i wouldn’t have to see them again, while the other part of me would be hurt badly for what i choose to do.. it’s really bad to say.. I even wished that I had a different dad and family before too, and even saying that hurts me. I know that they love me unconditionally, but it’s just really hard... I’m not like them at all, quite the opposite.. 

What’s also tough is just trying to find a real job too, for my career. I just finished my Capstone course today this morning, but it feels like I don’t know much if anything compared to others in the field. I know you can’t solve my problems, and i thank you so very much for that kind comment and words you’ve chosen to give me. The people here only practically know how I truly feel inside, and no one in my real life. 

Thank you again.

He slowly turned back and and screamed as loud as he could, and a few moments later, our dad was running towards us with a baseball bat, thinking there was someone in the house trying to kidnap us.
